title: wedelia acapulcensis var. parviceps
intro: Wedelia acapulcensis var. parviceps, commonly known as Mexican Tarragon or Mexican Marigold, is a flowering plant native to Mexico and parts of Central America. This plant is known for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Wedelia acapulcensis var. parviceps include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating a variety of ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
